summary.t: With lilac wings and a tulle skirt, with a flower in her hair.

text.t: A fairy with closed eyes, lilac wings, a layered pink skirt and a yellow flower in her hair. The wings and the skirt fill with points of light.

options.power.help.t: Batteries are not included. The cable version comes with a remote control: on, off, brightness control, auto-off and a slow pulsing light effect.

options.engraving.help.t: A name, a date or a short phrase, engraved on the wood. Leave blank if you prefer no engraving.
